title: CascadeLedger: Counterfactual Auditing of Information and Resource Integrity in LLM Cascades
abstract: arXiv:2610.20668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce CascadeLedger, a counterfactual execution-audit framework for budgeted language-model cascades. The protocol enforces call-before-read semantics, binds successful reads to service and cache identities, records availability and component-wise budget transitions, and freezes the event trace before any target or task scorer is joined. The central object is aggregate-equivalent trace validity: two executions can share a final answer, declared resource projection, and service histogram while differing in whether their routing decisions used only legitimately observable information. We complement single-trace invariants with counterfactual prefix non-interference (CPNI), which couples a visible prefix and policy randomness while changing only a declared hidden family. The counterfactual influence frontier (CIF) localizes the earliest violating prefix and a minimal hidden witness; projection-preserving adversarial mutation (PPAM)

translated_title: CascadeLedger：LLM级联中信息与资源完整性的反事实审计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CascadeLedger，一个面向预算受限语言模型级联的反事实执行审计框架。该协议强制执行“先调用后读取”语义，将成功的读取操作绑定到服务与缓存标识上，记录可用性状态及各组件的预算转换，并在接入任何目标模型或任务评分器之前冻结事件轨迹。其核心对象是聚合等价轨迹有效性：两次执行可以拥有相同的最终答案、声明的资源投影和服务直方图，但其路由决策是否仅使用了合法可观测的信息却可能存在差异。我们用反事实前缀无干扰性（CPNI）来补充单轨迹不变量，该性质在耦合可见前缀与策略随机性的同时，仅改变一个声明的隐藏族。反事实影响边界（CIF）定位最早违规的前缀以及一个最小隐藏见证；保持投影的对抗性变异（PPAM）
tldr: CascadeLedger提出了一个面向预算受限LLM级联的反事实执行审计框架，通过聚合等价轨迹有效性和反事实前缀无干扰性等机制，审计路由决策是否仅使用了合法可观测信息，并能定位最早违规点与最小隐藏见证。
en_tdlr: CascadeLedger is a counterfactual execution-audit framework for budgeted LLM cascades that verifies whether routing decisions used only legitimately observable information and localizes the earliest violating prefix via counterfactual prefix non-interference.
